Third-party software

xtrans2dng and xtrans2dng-gui use the libraries below. Each is the work of
its own authors and stays under its own license. This file is about those
libraries only.

rawler
    RAW decoding and DNG writing. By Daniel Vogelbacher and Pedro
    Côrte-Real.
    rawler and its use are covered by the GNU Lesser General Public
    License, version 2.1. The text is in LGPL-2.1.txt, next to this file.
    Source: https://github.com/dnglab/dnglab

option-ext
    In xtrans2dng-gui only. By Simon Ochsenreither.
    Mozilla Public License 2.0: https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
    Source: https://github.com/soc/option-ext
